summary: TeraWulf Inc. filed an 8-K to announce its acquisition of the Muskie Data Campus, a hyperscale development site in Eastern Kentucky, from Industrial Equity Partners. The deal closed May 22, 2026, for ~285 acres with option for adjacent land, supporting up to 1 GW data center capacity (500 MW ramp H2 2028, additional 500 MW H2 2030). No third-party consents or regulatory approvals required. Kentucky Power is constructing a 345 kV substation. Terms: price not disclosed. What to watch: execution on power delivery timeline; Bitcoin mining to AI pivot risk-arb.
